mechanism.base: Ore grows in the ground, in the dark of the stone and the wet that the stone holds. The earth does not pour it out. It gives up a little of its own weight, and what comes loose is harder and brighter than anything the ground was by itself. Metal is what the soil makes that can hold a point, and say in one clean line what the hillside spent an age holding.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Metal, the ground keeps every bit of its ore, all that weight and patience and nothing coming out with a finished shape. Say one thing plainly before it is perfect.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Metal, the hill is hollowed out by its own ore, every thought coming out finished and pointed while the ground under it thins. Keep one opinion back and sleep on it.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Metal makes it exact, each thing finished before it leaves you. As a catalyst, little gets through the gate and what does is made with care. A piece leaves you only when it meets your own standard.
function.definition_friction: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Metal gives it a hard finish, nothing left half done. As a friction, more goes out through the gate than comes back in, and it drains what holds you up. You wear yourself thin on getting it right.
function.definition_balanced: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Metal makes it exact, each thing finished before it leaves you. In balance, the gate opens when a piece is ready and closes when you need to rest. What you make and say leaves you whole.
function.advise_catalyst: Your standard is high enough that little ever leaves your hands. Give one thing you made to someone this month, as it is. Cut one draft in half and send the shorter one. Sign one piece of work.
function.advise_friction: Seek Fire, the Mind energy. Fire is warmth that goes in before anything comes out, the heat that softens what has gone hard and lets it bend. Let it warm what Metal has hardened. You give out faster than you refill. Enjoy one evening of music without judging a single note. Accept the next compliment with a plain thank you.
function.advise_balanced: Your Expression stays even while what you finish and what you keep back are both chosen with care. Cut one draft in half and send the shorter one. Sign one piece of work.

candidates.cta_verdict: You put a thing out finished rather than early, and what you say gets kept longer than you expect.

catalyst.clause: The ground keeps every bit of its ore.
catalyst.remedy: Say one thing plainly before it is perfect.

friction.clause: The hill is hollowed out by its own ore.
friction.remedy: Keep one opinion back and sleep on it.

wide.clause: You are well supplied with Metal, and the finished thing comes off you without strain.
wide.remedy: Use it. Make something and give it away.

missing.clause: No ore comes out of this ground, so what you know stays known and never said.
missing.remedy: Borrow an ending. Set a date and hand over the rough draft.

spared.clause: No ore leaves this ground, and the ground keeps its whole weight for itself.
spared.remedy: Leave it. Take things in before you put them out.

thin.clause: A thin seam of ore, a small drain on ground that needs its weight.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. Say less and settle more.

excess.clause: More ore than the ground can grow, and the soil that made it turns into something else.
excess.remedy: Dig less. Let the ground lie still and take in.

friction.clause: The mining never stops: everything minted, the topsoil stripped for output.

wide.clause: You have plenty of Metal, the ore your soil was keeping.
wide.remedy: Ship the piece that is already finished.

mechanism_yin.base: Metal is born of earth: it gathers under the field's stones, condensed out of long pressure and deep moisture, the ground's patience arriving at a point. The field speaks rarely. When it does, what it says is ore, and every refined thing that leaves the soil carries the field's patience inside it.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the mining never stops: everything minted, the topsoil stripped for output. Leave some ore in the ground. Your silence is part of the deposit.

__ore.retired_bonds_dip: People keep what you make: your rare words get quoted back years later.
__ore.retired_fn_body: The Voice is your expression function: the gate where inner ground becomes outer fact. With Metal running it, expression in you is smelted: few words, long formed, hard to argue with. You express by finishing, and your outputs carry an heirloom weight that louder voices never manage. Let things out before they are perfect. Ore refines in the open too.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Earth, and Earth feeds Metal: ore grows in the mountain. Whatever your ground pours itself into becomes your Expression, the channel where your patience turns to something refined and exact. Every precise word, every finished piece, every standard you quietly set is your years of holding, surfacing as edge. Mountains speak rarely. What they say is ore.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.mind: Writing sharpens your slow thinking: the sentence is where your ground finds its edge.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Metal is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is your patience surfacing as precision: the exact word, the finished piece, the standard people quote after you leave. You speak rarely and it lands.

The two-line email that settles a week of debate, the tool everyone borrows, the sentence colleagues repeat as policy: your quiet compounds into a reputation for saying true things well.

Scarcity is part of your signal, and shipping is the other part. Ship one polished thing a month, small is fine, finished is the point. Keep a file of your exact sentences. Volunteer the summary when talk runs long.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Metal is your Expression, and as a friction, it is output demanded from reserves that fill slowly: more deliverables, more opinions, more polish than your quiet depth can supply. Producing is starting to hollow you.

Asked for takes, drained by takes. Every meeting wants your read, every doc wants your pass, and the well-chosen words that used to feel like craft now feel like quota.

A slow well serves best when it is pumped rarely. Halve your output commitments for a quarter. Let the remaining work carry your full standard. Answer fewer threads, and let silence do some of your talking again.
